outcome.answer: Tool specifications can be used directly to generate synthetic agent test cases: extract meaning from function names, descriptions, and typed parameter schemas, enrich the schemas, create graded scenarios with synthetic tool outputs, and expand them into mock-data-grounded multi-turn dialogues [1]. The method can work from a single specification without examples, live tool access, or domain-specific tuning; its evaluation checks tool-calling correctness and conversational coherence, with argument-value accuracy a key weakness to inspect [1].
